records.meaning: A utility (mains) power failure has occurred and the UPS is supplying the load from battery power.
possible_causes: A utility failure has occurred and the UPS is in battery mode.
troubleshooting_steps: No corrective action required for the fault itself; this is a normal protective response to utility failure.
Prepare connected equipment for an orderly shutdown in case backup time runs out.
Wait for utility power to return; the UPS will automatically transfer back to Normal mode.
records.safety_warning: The UPS has its own internal power source (the battery); power outlets may remain energized even when the UPS is disconnected from the AC power source.
records.verification_notes: Verified against Eaton's official Eaton 5PX Advanced User Guide, document 614-40094-00. The manual covers model 5PX1500IRT2UG2. Printed troubleshooting references are pages 35-36.

records.issue_title: Battery running low while on battery power
records.meaning: The UPS is in Battery mode and the battery is running low (LED on, one beep every 3 seconds).
possible_causes: The UPS is in Battery mode and the battery is running low.
troubleshooting_steps: Treat this as an approximate warning; actual remaining runtime may vary significantly depending on load and number of Extended Battery Modules (EBMs).
The 'Battery Low' warning may occur before batteries reach 20% remaining capacity.
Shut down connected equipment before backup power is exhausted.
records.verification_notes: Verified against Eaton's official Eaton 5PX Advanced User Guide, document 614-40094-00. The manual covers model 5PX1500IRT2UG2. Printed troubleshooting references are pages 35-36.

records.meaning: The batteries are disconnected from the UPS (LED on, continuous beep).
troubleshooting_steps: Verify that all batteries are properly connected.
If the condition persists, contact your Eaton service representative.
records.safety_warning: Batteries present a risk of electric shock or burn from high short-circuit current and may contain high voltage and corrosive, toxic, explosive substances. Only qualified personnel should handle battery connections.

records.issue_title: UPS does not provide the expected backup time
records.meaning: The batteries need charging or servicing.
possible_causes: The batteries need charging or service.
troubleshooting_steps: Apply utility power for 48 hours to charge the batteries.
If the condition persists, contact your Eaton service representative.
records.verification_notes: Verified against Eaton's official Eaton 5PX Advanced User Guide, document 614-40094-00. The manual covers model 5PX1500IRT2UG2. Printed troubleshooting references are pages 35-36.

records.meaning: Power requirements exceed the UPS capacity (greater than 100% of nominal output rating).
possible_causes: Too much equipment connected to the UPS outlets
troubleshooting_steps: Remove some of the equipment from the UPS.
Note: the UPS continues to operate but may shut down if the load increases further.
The alarm resets automatically when the overload condition clears.
records.verification_notes: Verified against Eaton's official Eaton 5PX Advanced User Guide, document 614-40094-00. The manual covers model 5PX1500IRT2UG2. Printed troubleshooting references are pages 35-36.

records.meaning: The UPS internal temperature is too high or a fan has failed (LED on, one beep every 3 seconds). If temperature rises a further 10°C, the UPS shuts down.
possible_causes: The UPS internal temperature is too high.
troubleshooting_steps: Clear vents and remove any heat sources near the unit.
Allow the UPS to cool.
Ensure airflow around the UPS is not restricted.
Restart the UPS.
If the condition persists, contact your Eaton service representative.
records.verification_notes: Verified against Eaton's official Eaton 5PX Advanced User Guide, document 614-40094-00. The manual covers model 5PX1500IRT2UG2. Printed troubleshooting references are pages 35-36.

records.meaning: The UPS will not start when the power button is pressed.
possible_causes: Input power source is not connected correctly
The Remote Power Off (RPO) switch is active or the RPO connector is missing
troubleshooting_steps: Check the input and battery connections.
If the UPS Status menu displays the 'Remote Power Off' notice, deactivate the RPO input.
records.safety_warning: Dangerous voltage levels are present within the UPS; power outlets may remain energized even when disconnected from AC power.
